heading: Style 86cm XXL 16pl Fully Integrated Dishwasher
productFeatures: Door Pop-Out function opens the dishwasher door automatically to remove the steam inside.
shortDesc: 16 Place Settings, 16 Wash Programs, Auto Dosing, Sensi Clean™ Sensor, Wi-Fi (Diamond) Connectivity, WELS 6 Star/10.6L Per Wash, REG #D02796, Floor Projection
webCopy: Modern and effortless cleaning, now at your fingertips, with this ASKO Style 86cm XXL 16 Place Fully Integrated Dishwasher. Floor projection offers clear visibility of cycle progress with three colours indicating progress and status. The Super Cleaning System™ is a one-step program that tackles the toughest messes and saves you time. The XXL tub means you can fit all sizes of cookware and cutlery, without needing to run multiple cycles. The fully-integrated installation ensures this ASKO Dishwasher will match your cabinetry and kitchen surfaces, enhancing your interiors and home.

categoryAttributes.Additional Features: Child Lock,  Knife holder is extra deep so that the blades remain steady throughout the wash cycle.
